note: Built on Fe's raw `=` assignment primitive (itself the central divergence, tracked in fe's manifest as primitive-assign-eq), kg's setq macro already implements Emacs' multi-pair setq semantics on top of it: pairs of symbol/value forms, left-to-right evaluation, and returning the last assigned *value* (not nil, and not the symbol) -- verified directly: (setq a 1 b 2 c 3) is 3 in both languages.
